test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

P # Q means P is the wife of Q,

P - Q means P is the mother of Q,

P + Q means P is the father of Q,

P & Q means P is the son of Q.

Based on the above, how is E related to L in C # D + E # G + L?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ead17e04e9a5bd2288b06130ba6fe7ad3d5c96ba2e6596696d8b40dafe4e569d.png] 

As per the given information:

 
 

 
 
P is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
&

 
 
 

 
 
Means

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 

 
 
of Q

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

**Given expression:** 'C # D + E # G + L'

C is the wife of D, D is the father of E, E is the wife of G and G is the father of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6a4b06e94726edc6c11b180211de83f1857b7679ea9d0e04ec56ba2d63a81ad.png] 

Here, E is the mother of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
